titulo: Mothman vs The Jersey Devil: Who Won? 😰 #Shorts
titulo_pt: Mothman contra o Diabo de Jersey: quem venceu?
resumo_pt: Batalha de lendas. Um caminhoneiro para numa ponte velha à noite e vê o Diabo de Jersey e o Mothman se encarando. O Diabo de Jersey ataca primeiro, mas o Mothman abre as asas e acende os olhos vermelhos. O Diabo de Jersey olha nos olhos dele e foge pro mato gritando. O Mothman venceu sem encostar: quem olha nos olhos dele vê a própria morte. Aí ele vira pro caminhoneiro, que fecha os olhos até ele ir embora.
descricao:
Two legends. One bridge. Only one stayed.

Who do you think would win?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on classic American folklore. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: Mothman versus the Jersey Devil. Who wins?
scenes.pt: Mothman contra o Diabo de Jersey. Quem vence?
scenes.visual: a tall winged figure with glowing red eyes facing a horned winged creature on an old iron bridge at night

scenes.text: I'm a trucker. One night, I stopped on an old bridge to check a tire.
scenes.pt: Sou caminhoneiro. Uma noite, parei numa ponte velha pra olhar um pneu.
scenes.visual: trucker with a flashlight next to his truck on an old iron bridge at night

scenes.text: Something landed on the far end. Hooves. Bat wings. A horse's head.
scenes.pt: Uma coisa pousou do outro lado. Cascos. Asas de morcego. Cabeça de cavalo.
scenes.visual: creature with bat wings, hooves and a horse-like head landing on a bridge at night

scenes.text: Then a shadow dropped from the sky behind it. Seven feet tall. Two red eyes.
scenes.pt: Aí uma sombra caiu do céu atrás dele. Dois metros de altura. Dois olhos vermelhos.
scenes.visual: tall dark winged figure with two glowing red eyes standing behind a horned creature on a bridge

scenes.text: The Jersey Devil screamed and charged first.
scenes.pt: O Diabo de Jersey gritou e atacou primeiro.
scenes.visual: horned winged creature screaming and charging across a bridge at night

scenes.text: Mothman didn't move. He just opened his wings. They covered the whole bridge.
scenes.pt: O Mothman não se mexeu. Só abriu as asas. Elas cobriram a ponte inteira.
scenes.visual: huge dark wings spreading wide across an iron bridge at night

scenes.text: And his eyes started to glow brighter. And brighter.
scenes.pt: E os olhos dele começaram a brilhar mais forte. E mais forte.
scenes.visual: close up of two glowing red eyes in the dark, wings around them

scenes.text: The Jersey Devil looked straight into them. And stopped.
scenes.pt: O Diabo de Jersey olhou direto pra eles. E parou.
scenes.visual: horned creature frozen mid-step, red light on its face

scenes.text: It shrieked and flew into the woods. It never came back.
scenes.pt: Ele guinchou e fugiu voando pro mato. Nunca mais voltou.
scenes.visual: winged creature fleeing into a dark forest

scenes.text: Mothman won without touching it. They say whoever looks into his eyes sees how they'll die.
scenes.pt: O Mothman venceu sem encostar nele. Dizem que quem olha nos olhos dele vê como vai morrer.
scenes.visual: tall winged figure standing alone on the bridge, red eyes glowing

scenes.text: Then he turned to me. I shut my eyes and counted to a hundred.
scenes.pt: Aí ele virou pra mim. Fechei os olhos e contei até cem.
scenes.visual: trucker squeezing his eyes shut inside his truck cab, red glow on the windshield

scenes.text: When I opened them, the bridge was empty. I never looked.
scenes.pt: Quando abri, a ponte estava vazia. Eu nunca olhei.
scenes.visual: empty iron bridge at dawn with fog
